Do you have any problems like this?

  • I'm concerned about fine wrinkles around my eyes
  • Noticeable dark circles under the eyes
  • Are you worried about wrinkles on your cheeks, wrinkled skin, or sagging skin?
  • I am concerned about fine lines around my mouth.
  • I am concerned about vertical wrinkles around my mouth.
  • The skin is dull, lacks elasticity, and feels dry

What is beauty regenerative medicine “PRP therapy”?

PRP (platelet-rich plasma) therapy is a treatment that is also used for sports injuries and knee osteoarthritis.
By processing the patient's blood and injecting PRP into the affected area, we increase the tissue's self-healing ability.
By activating the production of collagen and elastin, you can expect various beauty effects. Since the treatment uses your own blood, there are almost no concerns about side effects from PRP treatment.

Effects of PRP therapy

1Aging care effect for the entire face

By increasing the self-repairing power of tissues, you can expect anti-aging effects on the entire face, such as improving wrinkles, sagging, dullness, and dry skin.

2Effect of skin regeneration

skin regeneration

Through skin regeneration, your skin will become more youthful from the inside out.

Basic treatment for acne scars

It is possible to fundamentally improve acne scars such as unevenness and redness. It also prevents acne recurrence.

Lifting and tightening of the face

You can expect a lifting effect that lifts and tightens the skin of your entire face.

Aging care around the eyes

It can be expected to improve small wrinkles around the eyes and dark circles under the eyes.

Improvement of back acne

Unlike facial acne, back acne is caused by Malassezia bacteria. PRP therapy is also effective for back acne.

Duration of effect

The effects of PRP therapy will be felt gradually over 2 weeks to 2 months as PRP releases various growth factors and promotes tissue repair.
Although there are individual differences, the effects last for about 6 months to 1 year.

Benefits of beauty PRP therapy

1No worries about side effects

The patient's own blood is used. Therefore, there is almost no need to worry about side effects, including allergic reactions.

2less downtime

There is almost no downtime after treatment, and you can return to your daily life and work immediately.

3long-lasting effect

Although there are individual differences, the effects last for about 6 months to 1 year. The effects last longer than hyaluronic acid injections.

Risks, side effects and precautions for PRP treatment

Risks/side effects

Internal bleeding, redness, swelling, and pigmentation may occur, but this usually subsides within a week, or at most a month.
In addition, skin regeneration begins about a week after treatment, and you may feel rough skin at that time, but this is due to the old keratin being peeled off and usually subsides within a month.

Those who cannot undergo treatment

  • Those who are pregnant
  • Those with a history of heart disease or cerebral infarction
  • People with diseases that tend to bleed
  • People who are taking medicines that thin the blood
  • People with liver disease
  • People with cancer, diabetes, immunodeficiency, collagen disease
  • Others who are deemed unsuitable by a doctor

Flow of treatment

1counseling

The doctor will carefully listen to you and explain anything you don't understand or have concerns about PRP therapy. We will listen to the patient's concerns and symptoms, and if we determine that PRP therapy is suitable, we will proceed with treatment.

2blood sampling

Collect the patient's blood. The collected blood is put into a centrifuge and the PRP is removed.

3PRP injection

PRP is injected into the affected areas.
Don't worry if you are concerned about pain as the injection is done under anesthesia.

4Aftercare

After your treatment, you can put on some makeup and go home.
At home, clean the affected area and use topical and oral medications if directed by your doctor.
You may wash your face and shower from the day of your appointment, but please refrain from bathing, saunas, strenuous exercise, and drinking alcohol.
